letters.text:
January, 10th, 2023

Dear. Mr. Caleb Ward

Nice to meet you.
I am an international student. I like rabbits, so please call me "Buchi Usagi🐰".

I'm studying English, but I'd be happy if I could write to you.

It's been cold lately.

Do you have anything warm over there?

January 16, 2023

Buchi Usagi,

Thanks for writing.

I wasn't sure anyone would actually pick my profile, so your letter was a surprise.

"Buchi Usagi" is a strange name, but all right. I'll use it.

We have heat here. Some days it works better than others. I've got a blanket and a sweatshirt, so I'm not freezing.

You said you're an international student and you're studying English. Your letter made sense to me. Don't worry too much about getting everything right.

Why rabbits?

Caleb

文通回数だけを理由に恋愛度や恋愛段階を上げない
